roads.name: National Forest Development Road 410
words: Curve after curve after curve: 93 in 4.5 miles, about 21 a mile.

The curves flow straight into one another.
From 5,200 to 6,026 ft, with 1,955 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 80°F.
Partly paved.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.82 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
